instruction: Create an ORIGINAL PURE-DART reusable package named aivexus_intersection_unique, Dart SDK >=3.3.0 <4.0.0. Implement exactly this PUBLIC TOP-LEVEL Dart function in lib/intersection_unique.dart: List<int> intersectStable(List<int> first, List<int> second). Return a NEW list of each integer that exists in both lists, listed once only in first-appearance order of first. Handle signed integers and empty lists. Do not mutate arguments. Fully implement working behavior yourself, not a stub. Write reasonable tests under test/. You may use Dart core List, Map, Set, loops and standard library methods only. No third-party runtime dependencies, networking, filesystem, FFI, shell or privileged APIs. Always use valid Dart SDK APIs and compileable types. Return the strict JSON source object requested by the system prompt.
